title: Colonel Alexander's precognitive sentient phenomenon at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: someone like Colonel Alexander to formulate what he called precognitive sentient phenomena.

plain: The strange events reported at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long studied for unexplained happenings, are said to have led a military officer known as Colonel Alexander to name what he faced "precognitive sentient phenomena": something aware that seems to know what the observers will do before they do it. The philosopher Jason Jorjani repeats this on the show, crediting the book Closer Encounters, as a sign that whatever is behind such events may be intelligent and able to anticipate those watching it.
